name: The Laundry Lounge
description: The Laundry Lounge brings Gulf Shores a modern, full-service laundromat experience with brand-new state-of-the-art machines, stylish interiors, and unbeatable amenities. We offer self-service laundry machines, wash and fold services, and commercial laundry solutions. Our facility features free high-speed Wi-Fi, a luxurious lounge to relax in while you wait, charging stations for your devices, and on-site assistance during staffed hours. We also offer specialized dog wash stations in separate rooms for convenience.
